title.zh: 真实采样乐器：SFZ 支持、R2 镜像与清单
title.en: Real sampled instruments: SFZ support, an R2 mirror and a manifest

highlights.zh: SFZ 子集解析器：包含 include、变量、per-region 继承、`<master>`；用真实库（1676 个 region）与 sfizz 逐音符对照。
highlights.en: An SFZ subset parser — includes, variables, per-region inheritance, `<master>` — verified note by note against sfizz and against a real 1676-region library.

highlights.zh: 清单（1659 个采样，哈希与体积齐全，实测最长 14.53 秒）随仓库发布；字节镜像到 R2。
highlights.en: A manifest of 1659 samples with hashes and sizes, longest measured at 14.53 s, shipped in the repository; the bytes are mirrored to R2.

highlights.zh: 采样地址**源优先**：源不可用才回退到镜像；两个地址都会在失败时被点名。
highlights.en: Sample addresses are **source-first**, falling back to the mirror only when the source fails, and both are named when both fail.
